title: Signal: npm publish token committed in the client configuration
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration.
limitations: It matches a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a registry authentication token written directly into the checked-in client configuration in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
